description: Use this when the person wants a sheet that keeps itself up to date from their emails or apps ("track my Amazon orders", "log my card spending"). Call it once the person has seen its columns and said yes. Sets up a ready-made track: makes the sheet in the person's Google Drive and attaches the hacks that fill it, so new messages become rows without you. Give a starter id from list_ready_made, or the person's words. If they already have that ready-made's sheet, the new source is added to it (created is false) and answers about the sheet's look are ignored; say so. Tell the person every line of tell_the_person. Not for copying a few emails into a sheet once.

choices.description: Answers by question id, like {"from": "amazon"}. Unanswered questions take the recommended answer.

forSharing.description: true makes a new, empty sheet set up the same way, with no hacks or links, to share with share_template: nothing of the person's can reach it.

starter.description: A ready-made track's id, from list_ready_made.

text.description: What the person wants to track, in their words, when you have no id.

name: start_tracking
title: Start a ready-made track
